items.description:
Redemption Burgers is a burger counter at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, Cape Town, open seven days a week from 9am to 6:30pm. The business partners with local artisans to source the most flavourful meat and produce it can find, and it describes its approach as real burgers made with passion, aiming for redemption in every bite.

Alongside its rustic burgers, the counter also sources a selection of the best local craft beers, pairing burgers and beer crafted to go together. Its menu is built around fresh, honest ingredients rather than mass-produced patties. It suits visitors to the Old Biscuit Mill who want a quality burger and a good local beer to go with it.

Simply Asia is a South African restaurant chain serving authentic Thai and Asian cuisine, with its menu developed by chefs trained by Thai culinary experts. The Plumstead branch, trading from the Richmond Centre on Main Road, offers both dine-in and takeaway service, with curries, noodles, rice dishes and other classic Thai-inspired dishes on the menu.

The branch is set up to accommodate groups as well as families with children, making it a practical option for a proper sit-down meal rather than only a quick takeaway stop. It suits diners in Plumstead who want a Thai or Asian meal without travelling into the city, whether that means eating in or collecting food to take home.

Sonnekus Boutique Hotel & Bistro is a 10-room guesthouse in St James, Cape Town, positioned for exploring the picturesque Southern Suburbs and the attractions in and around Kalk Bay. Its site describes the hotel as an experiential haven where fast lives slow down.

Each of the 10 guest rooms has a king-size or queen-size bed, an en-suite bathroom with lavish amenities and premium linen, and mountain or ocean views. Rooms also come with a flat-screen TV, complimentary Wi-Fi and gourmet tea and coffee facilities. The hotel also hosts corporate retreats alongside its bistro and cafe offering. It suits guests who want a relaxed stay with sea or mountain views close to Kalk Bay.

South Pole Studios is a pole dance and aerial fitness studio offering classes across pole dance, pole fitness, aerial hoop, aerial hammock, lyra and flexibility, led by qualified instructors. The studio's focus spans both pole-based training and other aerial disciplines, giving students a route into aerial fitness beyond a single style.

Current listings confirm the studio trades from 100 Voortrekker Road in Salt River, with classes run across weekday evenings and over weekends to suit people fitting training around work and other commitments. It suits anyone curious about pole or aerial fitness, from complete beginners through to more experienced students building on existing skills.

Sportscene is a sneaker and sportswear retailer stocking footwear and apparel from brands including Nike, Air Jordan, adidas Originals, PUMA, Converse and Vans, serving shoppers looking for branded sneakers and contemporary sports-inspired streetwear. The chain's ranges are built around current sneaker culture, with new releases and seasonal collections forming a core part of what's on the shop floor.

Business directory listings confirm this Sportscene branch trades from Maynard Mall on Main Road in Wynberg. It suits shoppers chasing the latest sneaker drops or streetwear pieces, whether building an outfit around a single pair of trainers or picking up a full sports-casual look.

items.description:
Sushi Box is part of the SushiBox restaurant group, serving sushi and Japanese-inspired dishes including rainbow rolls across its branches. The De Waterkant branch trades from Shop 5 in the Cape Quarter precinct, with counter and outdoor seating for diners wanting a casual sushi meal rather than a sit-down dinner.

Cape Quarter's own tenant listings confirm Sushi Box as one of the centre's food and drink outlets on Somerset Road. It suits customers after a sushi lunch, a casual dinner or a takeaway order while exploring the rest of the precinct, and the branch trades seven days a week from 11:30 to 20:30.

items.description:
The Cape Milner is a boutique hotel in Tamboerskloof, Cape Town, described by a travel site as among the best of the fairest Cape, offering impressive views and style at good prices. The hotel is perfectly located near major attractions, making it a convenient base for exploring the city.

Its highlights include a stunning glass lounge and bar area, offering a chic and relaxing space to unwind after a day out, along with luxury suites for guests who want extra space and comfort. It suits visitors who want a stylish, well-located base in Tamboerskloof for sightseeing around Cape Town. Its location in Tamboerskloof puts it within easy reach of the City Bowl, which suits visitors who want to explore on foot.

The Crafters Den is an arts and crafts store stocking a wide range of yarns, wool and haberdashery, alongside craft classes covering knitting, crochet, looming and tie-dye. The business began life in 2007 as Gadgets Arts & Crafts, expanding its product range over the years before relocating to Cape Town in 2022.

The shop trades from 37 Bergvliet Road in Bergvliet, and its classes give customers a way to learn a new craft skill rather than just buy the materials for one. It suits hobbyists stocking up on wool and haberdashery supplies as well as beginners wanting to learn crochet or looming from scratch.

The Crazy Store is a variety and discount retailer selling everyday household items, stationery, toys, gifts and general merchandise at affordable prices. The Tokai Junction branch forms part of a current, large nationwide network of stores trading under the same discount-variety format, with ranges running from kids' toys and party supplies to home accessories, seasonal costumes and gifting lines.

The shop trades from Shop G21 in Tokai Junction on Main Road, Kirstenhof, as confirmed by both the centre's own tenant information and the store's own business listing. It suits shoppers after an affordable top-up on household basics, party supplies, toys or small gifts without needing a special trip to a bigger retailer.

Totalsports is a sportswear and sporting goods retailer selling clothing, footwear and equipment for everyday training and fitness as well as for sports such as football and running. The brand trades as part of the TFG retail group, giving the Vangate Mall branch the backing of one of South Africa's larger clothing and footwear groups, with ranges that span multiple sporting codes rather than a single speciality.

Current location sources confirm this branch trades from Shop 23 in Vangate Mall on Jakes Gerwel Drive in Athlone. It suits shoppers kitting out for a specific sport, as well as those simply after everyday sports-inspired clothing, trainers and accessories for casual wear.

Trenton is a footwear retailer and South Africa's official distributor for a group of international brands, including UGG, Hunter, Løci, Holster, TOMS and FitFlop. Its range spans boots, sneakers, sandals and other footwear accessories across these brands under one roof, rather than stocking a single label.

The company's showroom trades from 82 Marine Drive in Paarden Eiland, with further Trenton stores in other parts of Cape Town and in Johannesburg. Customers can also browse the brand's online range for current season styles, with returns and exchanges handled through the same channel. It suits shoppers looking for genuine stock of these international footwear brands in one place, rather than searching out each brand separately.

Truth Coffee is an artisan coffee roastery and café serving breakfast, lunch, brunch and coffee-based drinks from a three-storey Victorian warehouse on Buitenkant Street. The space combines its roasting operation with sit-down dining, giving visitors a chance to see where the coffee they're drinking is roasted.

On selected evenings the café also runs Truth After.Dark, an after-hours concept offering coffee cocktails and mocktails alongside live jazz, extending the venue beyond its daytime café hours. It suits coffee drinkers and diners after a distinctive setting for a meal or a drink, whether visiting for a weekday breakfast or an evening session with live music.

Twigs Nursery & Coffee Shop combines a plant nursery and gift shop with a casual coffee shop, set in a bohemian garden-style space well suited to a slow visit. The nursery stocks plants, succulents, flowers, herbs and vegetables such as chillies, tomatoes and basil, alongside a gift-shop selection of handcrafted and handpicked arts and crafts.

The coffee shop side serves baked goods including carrot cake, cupcakes and ginger biscuits, plus vegan options and organic apple juice, alongside the usual coffee, tea and snacks. The business trades from Shop 5 on Second Avenue in Harfield Village. It suits plant shoppers, gift buyers and anyone wanting a relaxed coffee stop in a garden setting.

Umami Sushi has served sushi and Asian-inspired cuisine from the Imhoff Farm property in Kommetjie since 2015, with a focus on fresh seafood and sushi prepared to order. The restaurant offers both a garden courtyard and an indoor dining area, giving diners a choice between an outdoor farm setting and a more sheltered space.

Beyond regular dining, the restaurant also caters for small private functions, making it an option for a family celebration or small gathering rather than only a casual meal out. It suits local residents and visitors to Imhoff Farm looking for sushi or Asian-style food, and it trades seven days a week from midday until 9pm.

Umi is a modern Japanese restaurant on the upper deck of the Marly Hotel in Camps Bay, serving sushi and other Japanese dishes either à la carte or through set menus. The restaurant looks out over the bay, with a terrace and ocean views forming part of the dining experience alongside the food.

The venue also offers secure parking and space for larger private events, making it an option for a group booking as well as a regular dinner out. It suits diners after a sushi or Japanese meal with a view, whether for a casual dinner or a bigger private occasion.

Veloce Luxury Car Rental offers self-drive and chauffeur-driven luxury vehicles, including supercars, sports cars, luxury SUVs, 4x4s, convertibles and executive cars, drawn from a fleet of more than 50 vehicles. Beyond standard rentals, the company also arranges airport vehicle delivery and transport for events such as matric dances, giving clients options beyond simply picking up a car from a counter.

The showroom trades from the Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village on Somerset Road in De Waterkant, alongside the centre's other shops and restaurants. It suits visitors and tourists wanting a self-drive luxury car for their stay, as well as executives and event clients who prefer chauffeur-driven travel over driving themselves, whatever the occasion.

Venture Workspace is a coworking space provider with a branch at Constantia Emporium Mall in Constantia, Cape Town. The site positions the location as a way to avoid time wasted in traffic, with a convenient workspace close to the M3 and top lifestyle amenities.

The Constantia branch offers membership plans designed to grow with a business, from freelancers starting out to established entrepreneurs and growing teams. The site highlights ample, secure tenant parking and biometric access as part of the member experience. The company also runs other locations across Cape Town, including Claremont, Riverlands and Somerset West. It suits freelancers, small businesses and teams who want a flexible workspace in Constantia.

Vida e Caffe is a South African café franchise, founded in 2001 and inspired by the style of Portuguese espresso bars, serving coffee and light food. It has grown into the largest café chain in the country by number of outlets, now operating around 400 stores across South Africa and several neighbouring African countries, and trades today as part of the Shoprite Holdings group. The brand also operates sweetbeet, a smaller, health-focused restaurant chain under the same parent company.

The Edgemead branch trades as Shop 10 in Edgemead Village Centre, confirmed by the centre's own tenant listing. It suits local residents and shoppers after a quick coffee or a light bite while running errands around the village centre, rather than a sit-down restaurant meal.

Voltmill is a company specialising in alternative energy solutions in the Western Cape, based in Ndabeni, Cape Town. Its offering covers generators, through partnerships with leading South African suppliers, and solar power systems for homes and businesses wanting to generate their own electricity.

The company positions energy security as essential to modern life in South Africa, given rising electricity costs and ongoing load shedding, and says it has solutions for all budgets, whether the goal is going off the grid entirely or simply saving money. It suits homeowners and businesses who want a reliable, tailored generator or solar installation to manage power cuts and energy costs.

Wayne Hodgkinson Optometrists trades from G4, Steenberg Village Centre on Reddam Avenue in Tokai, Cape Town, as part of the Good Vision network. The practice's directory listing shows its trading hours as Monday to Friday from 08:30 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 08:30 to 12:00, closed on Sundays.

The practice is listed under ophthalmologists, optometrists and opticians, and patients can send an email enquiry or write a review through its directory listing. It suits patients in Tokai and nearby suburbs who want routine eye examinations and vision care close to Steenberg Village Centre. Patients can also claim through most major medical aid schemes for eye tests and spectacles bought at the practice.

items.description:
Woodville Primary School is a primary school serving learners and their families in the Woodlands area of Mitchells Plain. A school-issued document setting out its ethos describes an aim to provide a safe and diverse educational experience, with the stated goal of developing well-rounded individuals rather than focusing on academic results alone.

The school is based on Juno Street in Woodlands, Mitchells Plain, within the wider Mitchells Plain community it draws most of its learners from. It suits families in the area looking for a local primary school with a clearly stated focus on learners' broader development, alongside their everyday classroom education.

Woolworths at Waterstone Village is a large-format Woolworths Food store selling fresh produce, bakery products, prepared meals and other Woolworths food lines, alongside an in-store sushi bar. At its 2013 expansion, Woolworths Holdings described the branch as its largest Woolworths Food Market at the time, spanning almost 2,500m² with 19 tills, including five express lanes.

The store also includes a WCafé, serving meals, pastries, breads, coffee and other drinks for shoppers wanting to eat in rather than just shop. Woolworths remains one of the main tenants at Waterstone Village in Somerset West. It suits shoppers after a full grocery shop, fresh food or a WCafé meal in a single visit, without needing a smaller-format store as well.

Zeetan Turkish Restaurant is a halal Turkish restaurant and shisha lounge on Main Road in Sea Point, Cape Town, described as a relaxed late-night spot. The menu covers grills, Middle Eastern dishes, pizza, steakhouse cuts and vegetarian options, alongside its shisha offering.

The restaurant trades from 09:00 to 01:00 Sunday to Friday and until 03:00 on Saturdays, making it a late-night option in Sea Point. It is Muslim-owned and halal certified. It suits diners who want late-night Turkish food and shisha in a relaxed setting. The restaurant suits groups who want to share a mixed grill or pizza over shisha into the early hours.

1UP Cash & Carry is a retail and wholesale outlet in Epping, Cape Town, that combines both forms of trading under one roof with the promise of getting more for less. Its product range spans categories including baby and toddler items, bakery goods, groceries, beverages and household and personal care products.

The business takes orders online, and its site notes that due to high order volumes, deliveries may take up to 48 hours, with orders placed on Sunday delivered the following Monday. It serves as the chain's flagship store in Epping. It suits independent traders and households who want to buy groceries and household goods in bulk at wholesale prices.

African Experience is a craft shop in Noordhoek Farm Village, Cape Town, trading in summer from 08:30 to 17:30 and in winter from 09:00 to 17:00. The shop offers an extraordinary range of eclectic, contemporary and imaginative handmade African crafts.

It is a founding member of Proudly South African and an official stockist of Carrol Boyes functional art, having won a Carrol Boyes silver award, which reflects its standing among stockists of that brand. It suits shoppers at Noordhoek Farm Village looking for a distinctive, locally made gift or decor piece. The shop's range gives shoppers a way to buy a single piece or build a themed collection of African art for the home.

Aiyara Thai Restaurant is a Thai restaurant tucked away in Little Mowbray, Cape Town, which its own site calls a hidden gem and one of the city's finest Thai dining destinations. The restaurant describes itself as a Thai haven where culinary excellence meets warmth and homeliness.

Its approach to authentic Thai cuisine aims to capture the heart and soul of the culinary tradition, with a homely ambience and a humble approach to dining. The team says its secret lies in the passion put into every dish, so each bite takes diners on a flavourful journey through Thailand. It suits diners who want an intimate, authentic Thai meal away from the busier parts of the city.

Arora Lights is a lighting retailer supplying indoor and outdoor lighting, including chandeliers, pendants, ceiling fittings, wall lights, downlights, spotlights, fans, garden lighting, floodlights and solar lighting. The business has traded since 1987 and has grown into one of the larger lighting retailers in the Western Cape, serving residential, commercial and other customers who need both products and advice on fittings.

A projects division handles lighting design, sourcing and installation for larger jobs, alongside walk-in retail sales from the showroom. The current branch trades from Unit 1 on Gold Street in Northgate Estate, Ysterplaat. It suits homeowners replacing a single fitting as well as businesses needing a full lighting design and installation service.

Backyard Brew Coffee Co. is a coffee roaster based at 74 Pinehurst Road in Kenwyn, Cape Town, trading Monday to Saturday from 07:30 to 18:00. Collection from the roastery is available by arrangement, and the business offers free local delivery in Cape Town for orders over R500 at any time of the month.

Customers can reach the team by phone or email for questions about the company, its services or its coffee range, and the business also runs a monthly newsletter. It suits coffee drinkers who want freshly roasted beans delivered locally or collected directly from the roastery.

Baia Seafood Restaurant is an elegant harbourside restaurant with a Portuguese soul, on the Upper Level at Quay 6 in the Quays District of the V&A Waterfront. It specialises in beautifully prepared seafood dishes served with panoramic views and an extensive wine list, making it suited to a long, leisurely lunch or a romantic evening.

The restaurant trades Monday to Wednesday from 6pm to 10pm and Thursday to Sunday from midday to 3:30pm, and it holds a 4.4 rating from more than 1,100 Google reviews through its Waterfront listing. Guests can park at the Victoria Wharf parkade nearby. It suits diners who want fine seafood dining with harbour views at the Waterfront.

Banana Jam Café is a Caribbean-inspired restaurant and brewpub serving its own beer alongside curries, cocktails and barbecue-style food, with spit braais among its offerings. A local business directory listing describes a venue built around regular happy-hour promotions, barbecues, beer festivals and private events, on top of its everyday food and drinks menu.

The café trades from Second Avenue, giving it an easy, laid-back setting for a casual meal or a drink. It suits groups after a relaxed spot for cocktails, Caribbean-style food and its own-brewed beer, as well as anyone wanting to catch one of its regular happy-hour or beer-festival events.

BarStaurant is a family-friendly restaurant at the Glencairn Hotel in Glencairn, Cape Town, set across from Glencairn beach. A Cape Town Magazine feature describes it as False Bay's newest restaurant at the time, offering top sushi, gorgeous sea views and a good wine selection.

The feature highlights the restaurant's jungle gym, which makes it a practical choice for families with children, alongside its food and wine offering. It suits families who want a relaxed meal with sea views and something to keep children entertained. The hotel setting also means guests can combine a meal with a stay nearby, making it convenient for a full day out in Glencairn.

Beau Constantia is a boutique wine farm at the top of Constantia Nek in Cape Town, with vineyard and mountain views. The estate's Family Range of Wines takes its names from the owners of the estate, with each fruit meticulously hand-raised from farm to bottle, while its Pas De Nom Range honours Oom Japie Bronn, the first farm manager, who established the estate's high-altitude vineyards on the steep slopes of the Vlakkenberg.

Wine tasting and the on-site Chefs Warehouse restaurant are run as separate entities, each with its own booking link, so visitors should contact the correct department to avoid delays securing a reservation. The restaurant serves lunch daily from 12h00 to 14h00 and dinner Monday to Saturday from 18h30 to 20h00. It suits wine lovers who want to taste estate wines alongside a seasonal tasting menu with vineyard views.

Belthazar Restaurant & Wine Bar is an award-winning steakhouse and wine bar in Victoria Wharf at the V&A Waterfront. The restaurant is home to what it calls the biggest wine-by-the-glass bar in the world, with 250 wines served in Riedel glassware and up to 600 different wines in stock.

Its kitchen specialises in export-quality grain-fed and grass-fed beef, alongside an authentic selection of South African game that includes blesbok, gemsbok, kudu and crocodile. Experienced sommeliers serve the wines and advise guests on the full range, which is stored in a designer Vinoteque with dual temperature and humidity controls for red and white wines. It suits diners who want a serious wine experience alongside a beef and game-focused menu.

Bergman Ross & Partners Radiologists is a radiology practice with a branch at The Point in Sea Point, part of a group that started as a small practice in Cape Town in 1995. The practice has since grown to include multiple branches across the Western Cape and Gauteng, while maintaining what it describes as a client-centred approach.

Its stated aim is to provide a radiological service of the highest standard, with particular attention to accurate diagnoses for referring doctors and maximising patient care while minimising waiting time. The practice says it works to create warm, friendly environments with efficient, empathetic staff, prioritising the safety and wellbeing of clients in cooperation with referring physicians. It suits patients who need diagnostic imaging in a practice with an established, multi-branch radiology network behind it.

BKB Boards & Hardware is a supplier and distributor of wood-based board products and hardware, based in Kensington, Cape Town. The business describes its model as cut, edge, drill, deliver, offering expert cutting, edging and drilling services to meet customer project needs alongside its board and hardware range.

Customers can browse its catalogue and order online for a custom quote through its cutlist service, with secure online payment. Its product range includes nails and anchors, machine screws and drywall screws in various sizes, alongside the wood-based boards it specialises in. It suits cabinet makers, contractors and DIY customers who need boards cut and finished to size rather than bought as raw sheets.

Black Oak Computers provides computer repair, diagnostics and IT consulting services, covering everything from desktop and notebook repairs and upgrades to assessing troublesome PCs and laptops. Common software issues such as errors and blue screens are part of its day-to-day repair work, alongside hardware-related problems and upgrades for older machines.

Business directories also classify the company as a computer systems and related-services provider, and separately list it as a used-computer retailer. It trades from 23 Sunnydale Road in Sunnydale. It suits customers with a malfunctioning computer or laptop who want it assessed and repaired locally, rather than simply replaced outright with something new.

Bootlegger Coffee Company's Bakoven branch serves specialty-grade coffee alongside all-day breakfast, lunch and brunch, trading seven days a week. The café also offers takeaway for customers who want their coffee and food on the go rather than sitting in.

A travel-review listing for the branch describes it as a trendy, laid-back coffee spot known for sourcing and roasting its own beans, with breakfast options including a build-your-own breakfast and a classic eggs Benedict with salmon. The branch trades from 38 Victoria Road in Bakoven. It suits anyone wanting a relaxed coffee stop with a proper breakfast menu rather than just a quick espresso.

Bootlegger – Dean Street is a specialty coffee café inside the Dean Street Arcade in Newlands, part of the wider Bootlegger Coffee Company chain. The branch serves all-day breakfast, lunch and brunch, with free Wi-Fi and a kids' menu among its facilities, plus takeaway for customers who prefer to eat on the move.

A local coffee-shop directory lists the branch as a reliable choice for coffee in Newlands, trading from Shop T16 in the Dean Street Arcade. It suits families and regulars looking for a dependable neighbourhood coffee spot, whether for a sit-down breakfast or a takeaway coffee on the way through the arcade.

items.description:
BUCO Bergvliet is a hardware and building-materials store at Shop 11, Harry Goemans Centre on Main Road in Bergvliet, Cape Town. The branch's page says an early start is every builder's best friend, so the store opens from 07:30 each morning to suit tradespeople starting work early.

The store positions itself as the natural stop for anyone in Bergvliet involved in building and construction, or with a love of DIY and crafts, stocking industry-leading brands at competitive prices. Customers can browse the online store before visiting in person to see the range for themselves. It suits builders and DIY customers in Bergvliet who want an early-opening hardware store with a wide brand range.

Cape Royale Hotel is a 5-star luxury suites hotel in Green Point, Cape Town, close to the V&A Waterfront and De Waterkant. The property offers a rooftop pool deck, secure on-site parking and what its own site describes as a royal welcome for guests.

Its positioning, summed up as living the life of luxury, easy, points to suites rather than standard hotel rooms, with property management handling enquiries directly by phone or email. It suits visitors who want a luxury, self-catering style stay within easy reach of the Waterfront and De Waterkant. Guests staying for longer periods benefit from the self-catering suite layout, which gives more space than a standard hotel room.

The practice, trading as Healthjunction, is a physiotherapy and Pilates practice based in the Cape Town City Bowl, established in 2006 by a physiotherapist with more than 26 years of experience at the time. The practice was created to offer optimal results through an integrated programme of treatment, rehabilitation and long-term maintenance for patients.

Today, Healthjunction has a passionate and highly skilled team offering physiotherapy, Pilates and massage, dedicated to providing exceptional care and strong results for patients. The practice's approach blends short-term treatment with a longer-term maintenance plan, rather than treating physiotherapy as a one-off fix. It suits patients in Vredehoek and the City Bowl who want physiotherapy and Pilates handled by one coordinated team.

CCI Technology Solutions is an IT infrastructure and networking company based in Ndabeni, Cape Town, describing itself as more than just an IT convergence company and instead a partner in seamless communication solutions. Its core business covers data, voice and fibre optic connectivity, cutting-edge wireless networks, environmental monitoring, LAN network design and integration, and data centres and comms rooms.

The company says it specialises in tailoring its IT services to each client's unique needs, with a steadfast commitment to customer satisfaction. Its environmental monitoring service is aimed at ensuring the safety and sustainability of a client's infrastructure. It suits businesses that need structured cabling, wireless networking or comms room infrastructure designed and installed by a specialist provider.

Clicks Delft Mall is a branch of the South African health, beauty and personal-care retail chain, combining general Clicks retail with an in-store pharmacy. The pharmacy offers prescription dispensing and other pharmacy services alongside the wider store's personal care, beauty and over-the-counter health ranges, plus the chain's usual loyalty and rewards programme.

The branch's own store page confirms it trades from Shop 7 in Delft Mall on Hindle Road, Delft, as both a retail store and a registered pharmacy. It suits shoppers in Delft after everyday health, beauty and personal-care products, as well as anyone needing a prescription filled or pharmacy advice close to home.

Clicks Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy operating as part of the national Clicks health, beauty and personal-care chain, combining dispensing services with the wider store's beauty and everyday health ranges. The Philippi branch gives shoppers at The Junxion Mall access to both a pharmacy and general Clicks retail under one roof.

Medpages' listing for this branch, last updated in mid-2026, and current map data both confirm the store trading from Shop 21 in The Junxion Mall, on the corner of Govan Mbeki and New Eisleben Road. It suits shoppers at the mall who want to pick up a prescription or pharmacy advice alongside their usual shopping.

Colosseum Hotel is a four-star, all-suite hotel in Century City, Cape Town, ideally located for both business and leisure travellers with easy access to the area's shopping and conference districts. The hotel offers spacious suites and penthouses, and guests who book directly are offered a best price guarantee along with discounted upgrade offers when a higher room category is available.

The hotel also offers flexible payment terms through Payflex, letting guests split their payment into instalments at checkout. It has strong ratings across major booking and review platforms, based on a large number of verified reviews. It suits business travellers and leisure guests who want self-catering suites close to Century City's shopping and conference venues.
